set_province_feature = {
	$TITLE$ = {
		if = {
			limit = { tier > tier_county }
			every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				limit = {
					tier = tier_county
					NOT = { is_in_list = excluded_provinces }
				}
				add_county_modifier = $MODIFIER$
			}
		}
		else = { add_county_modifier = $MODIFIER$ }
	}
}

set_arcane_fallout = {
	$TITLE$ = {
		if = {
			limit = { tier > tier_county }
			every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				limit = { tier = tier_county }
				set_variable = {
					name = arcane_fallout
					value = $VALUE$
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				name = arcane_fallout
				value = $VALUE$
			}
		}
	}
}

############################
# BUILDING STARTUP EFFECTS #
############################

# Ensures that a holding is properly empty
reset_holding_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { 
			has_holding_type = castle_holding
		}
		set_holding_type = tribal_holding
		set_holding_type = castle_holding
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 
			has_holding_type = city_holding
		}
		set_holding_type = tribal_holding
		set_holding_type = city_holding
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 
			has_holding_type = church_holding
		}
		set_holding_type = tribal_holding
		set_holding_type = church_holding
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_holding_type = tribal_holding
		}
		set_holding_type = castle_holding
	}
}

set_historical_holding_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { 
			current_date > $DATE$
		}
		add_building = $BUILDING$
	}
}

generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = {
	random_list = {
		30 = {
			while = {
				count = $MAJOR$
				generate_building = yes
			}
		}
		70 = {
			trigger = { barony = { is_capital_barony = no } }
			while = {
				count = $MINOR$
				generate_building = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Initialize preset historical buildings in counties. Used because the province history way of handling it is currently buggy due to not accounting for building slots
initialize_historical_buildings_effect = {
	# Kalathipsomi
	title:b_hunters_keep.title_province = {
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	# Kharadamat
	title:b_heilat_ul_suqq.title_province = {
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	title:b_byzaropol.title_province = {
		reset_holding_buildings_effect = yes
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	title:b_jidd_aleh.title_province = {
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	
	title:b_ruqeh.title_province = {
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	
	title:b_muqshah.title_province = {
		reset_holding_buildings_effect = yes
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	title:b_der_khulaybah.title_province = {
		refill_garrison = yes
		refill_levy = yes
		set_variable = historical_buildings_manually_added
	}
	
	every_province = {
		limit = {  
			has_holding = yes
			NOT = { exists = var:historical_buildings_manually_added }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:h_sarradon
					empire = title:e_ayyar
					empire = title:e_amsari_hiklahn
				}
			}
			generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = { MAJOR = 15 MINOR = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_kratemezin
					empire = title:e_damota
				}
				NOT = {
					kingdom = title:k_aekershaan
				}
			}
			generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = { MAJOR = 12 MINOR = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_chevalie
					kingdom = title:k_de_kanzelerij
					kingdom = title:k_gisredde
				}
			}
			generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = { MAJOR = 10 MINOR = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_rovarska
					empire = title:e_naavjagarad
					empire = title:e_darmirat
					kingdom = title:k_arbaz
				}
			}
			generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = { MAJOR = 20 MINOR = 12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_dahangon
					empire = title:e_nanmay_bon
				}
			}
			generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = { MAJOR = 15 MINOR = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				game_start_date >= 6298.1.1
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_etepezea
					empire = title:e_opakhasia
					empire = title:e_cornucopia
					empire = title:e_the_reach
					empire = title:e_black_mountains
					empire = title:e_asiupoliox
					kingdom = title:k_cyrocaea
				}
			}
			generate_historical_holding_buildings_effect = { MAJOR = 8 MINOR = 4 }
		}
		brewery_counter_start_effect = yes # Moved here from vanilla to make sure these get spread out properly
	}
	every_domicile = { # Moved here from vanilla to make sure they're properly generated
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_domicile_type = estate
				exists = owner
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = estate_main_02 }
					owner.culture ?= { has_innovation = innovation_city_planning }
				}
				add_domicile_building = estate_main_02
				add_random_internal_estate_building = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_domicile_building = estate_main_02
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = estate_main_03 }
					owner.culture ?= { has_innovation = innovation_manorialism }
				}
				add_domicile_building = estate_main_03
				while = {
					count = 2
					add_random_internal_estate_building = yes
				}
			}

			fill_external_estate_building_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

#####################################
# DEVELOPMENT LEVEL STARTUP EFFECTS #
#####################################

development_growth_period_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= $START$ }
		if = {
			limit = { current_year < $END$ }
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = year_diff
				value = {
					value = current_year
					subtract = $START$
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = year_diff
				value = {
					value = $END$
					subtract = $START$
				}
			}
		}
		change_development_progress_with_overflow = {
			value = scope:year_diff
			multiply = $GROWTH_RATE$
		}
	}
}

development_growth_change_factor_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= $YEAR$ }
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = development_diff
			value = {
				value = development_level
				multiply = $FACTOR$
				floor = yes
			}
		}
		change_development_level = scope:development_diff
	}
}

initialize_historical_development_effect = {
	every_county = {
		limit = { is_landless_type_title = no }
		if = {
			limit = {
				title_province = { geographical_region = world_ga_mayikprolollan_mayikprolollan_depths }
			}
			change_development_level = 1 # Set manually to avoid growth, keep sparse across all start dates
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				title_province = { geographical_region = world_ga_mayikprolollan_mayikprolollan_surface }
			}
			change_development_level = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_etepezea
					empire = title:e_the_reach
					empire = title:e_cornucopia
					empire = title:e_black_mountains
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5001 END = 5600 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow, stable growth throughout the expansion of the empire
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5600 FACTOR = -0.3 }	# Kartharaddi wars significantly damage development (GH TODO: Make this more gradual)
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5760 END = 5900 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_high_value }	# Rapid recovery and growth during the Theyssian Golden Age
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5901 END = 6150 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow and stable development leading up to the 13th century
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.75 }	# ICW & Frodbrokna; somewhat spared compared to the rest of the empire
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6254 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Post-Frodbrokna chaos, very little development recovery
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.2 }	# Battle of Elysia
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6254 FACTOR = 0.4 } # Migrations
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_opakhasia
					empire = title:e_aironoi
					empire = title:e_malcois
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5001 END = 5600 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow, stable growth throughout the expansion of the empire
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5600 FACTOR = -0.3 }	# Kartharaddi wars significantly damage development (GH TODO: Make this more gradual)
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5760 END = 5900 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_high_value }	# Rapid recovery and growth during the Theyssian Golden Age
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5901 END = 6050 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_medium_value }	# Slow and stable development leading up to the 13th century
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6051 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Stagnation leading up to the turmoil of the late 13th century
			if = {
				limit = { kingdom = title:k_krehejad }
				development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.8 }	# ICW & Frodbrokna
			}
			else = {
				development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.95 }	# ICW & Frodbrokna
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6254 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Post-Frodbrokna chaos, very little development recovery
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6275 FACTOR = 0.4 } # Migrations
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_chevalie
					kingdom = title:k_de_kanzelerij
					kingdom = title:k_gisredde
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5200 END = 5800 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow, stable growth until the Anarchy of the Five Crowns
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5900 FACTOR = -0.6 }	# Ao5K & Red River War
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5901 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow growth until Frodbrokna
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.15 }	# Frodbrokna; largely spared
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6300 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:h_sarradon
					empire = title:e_ayyar
					empire = title:e_amsari_hiklahn
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5001 END = 5802 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow growth until the Halakdun
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5802 FACTOR = -0.8 }	# Halakdun
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5802 END = 5850 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Little to no development increase during the post-Halakdun anarchy
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5851 END = 5900 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_high_value }	# Period of rapid recovery following the end of the chaotic period after the Halakdun
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5901 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_medium_value }	# Stable development leading up to Frodbrokna
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.5 }	# Frodbrokna
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6300 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_medium_value }	# Continued stable growth after Frodbrokna
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						duchy = title:d_aversaria_peripontica
						duchy = title:d_thronelands
					}
				}
				development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5802 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = 2.5 }	# Aversaria Peripontica especially prospered during the Imperial Golden Age
				development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.4 }	# Frodbrokna	# But it was also hit much more heavily by Frodbrokna than the rest of Sarradon
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_kratemezin
					empire = title:e_damota
				}
				NOT = {
					kingdom = title:k_aekershaan
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5001 END = 5802 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Slow growth until the Halakdun
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5802 FACTOR = -0.5 }	# Halakdun
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5802 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Continued slow growth until Frodbrokna
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.3 }	# Frodbrokna
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6300 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# Continued slow growth after Frodbrokna
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_rovarska
					empire = title:e_naavjagarad
					empire = title:e_darmirat
					kingdom = title:k_arbaz
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5001 END = 5800 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }	# GH TODO: Granularize this for future start dates
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5802 FACTOR = -0.5 }	# Scholarly apocalypses
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6002 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.25 }	# Frodbrokna
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6300 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					empire = title:e_dahangon
					empire = title:e_nanmay_bon
				}
			}
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 5400 END = 5800 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 5802 FACTOR = -0.1 }	# Scholarly apocalypses
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6002 END = 6200 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }
			development_growth_change_factor_effect = { YEAR = 6200 FACTOR = -0.15 }	# Frodbrokna
			development_growth_period_effect = { START = 6201 END = 6300 GROWTH_RATE = historical_development_growth_slow_value }
		}
	}
}

####################################
# BORDERING THE FOG DYNAMIC EFFECT #
####################################

gh_bordering_fog_dynamic_effect = { # Adds "Bordering the Fog" county modifiers to appropriate counties
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_landless_type_title = no 
			has_county_modifier = fogswept_modifier
			any_neighboring_county = {
				NOR = {
					has_county_modifier = fogswept_modifier
					has_county_modifier = bordering_fog_modifier
				}
			}
		}
		every_neighboring_county = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_county_modifier = fogswept_modifier
					has_county_modifier = bordering_fog_modifier
				}
			}
			add_county_modifier = bordering_fog_modifier
		}
	}
}

########################################
# WASTELAND AND RUIN CONSISTENCY CHECK #
########################################

gh_wasteland_and_ruin_check_effect = { # This checks for various errors related to playable characters with wasteland holdings etc
	if = {
		limit = {
			holder = { is_ruin = no }
			OR = {
				culture = culture:wasteland
				faith = faith:wasteland_faith
				any_county_province = { has_holding_type = wasteland_empty_holding }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { culture = culture:wasteland }
			set_county_culture = holder.culture
			debug_log = debug_log.non_wasteland_holder.wasteland_culture
			debug_log_scopes = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wasteland_faith }
			set_county_faith = holder.faith
			debug_log = debug_log.non_wasteland_holder.wasteland_faith
			debug_log_scopes = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_county_province = { has_holding_type = wasteland_empty_holding } }
			every_county_province = {
				limit = { has_holding_type = wasteland_empty_holding }
				set_holding_type = ruin_holding
				province_owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { highest_held_title_tier = tier_barony }
						change_government = feudal_government
					}
				}
				debug_log = debug_log.non_wasteland_holder.wasteland_holding
				debug_log_scopes = no
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			holder = { is_ruin = yes }
			NOR = {
				culture = culture:wasteland
				faith = faith:wasteland_faith
				any_county_province = {
					OR = {
						has_holding_type = wasteland_empty_holding
						has_holding_type = ruin_holding
						has_holding_type = ruined_district_holding
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { culture = culture:wasteland } }
			set_county_culture = holder.culture
			debug_log = debug_log.wasteland_holder.non_wasteland_culture
			debug_log_scopes = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { faith = faith:wasteland_faith } }
			set_county_faith = holder.faith
			debug_log = debug_log.wasteland_holder.non_wasteland_faith
			debug_log_scopes = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_county_province = {
					NOR = {
						has_holding_type = wasteland_empty_holding
						has_holding_type = ruin_holding
						has_holding_type = ruined_district_holding
					}
				}
			}
			every_county_province = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						has_holding_type = wasteland_empty_holding
						has_holding_type = ruin_holding
						has_holding_type = ruined_district_holding
					}
				}
				set_holding_type = ruin_holding
				debug_log = debug_log.wasteland_holder.non_wasteland_holding
				debug_log_scopes = no
			}
		}
	}
}
